route: Own RTD mechanism experiment; not a reproduction of Q-FT and no author score adopted
hypothesis: Within-column marginal-preserving replacement detection may train jointly useful conditional representations beyond the same randomly initialized supervised encoder. Existing conditional-rating pretext features do not test this shared-encoder RTD mechanism.

architecture.features: Raw21 only:17numeric+4nominal; no ID, SAT feature, TE, teacher, or original-source predictions
architecture.attention: Full noncausal within-row attention only; no positions, RoPE, local masks, or cross-row attention
architecture.column_identity: Learned column embedding travels with each token; numeric affine value/missing embedding or nominal category embedding; learned CLS token
architecture.missing: Numeric missing flag is inside token and follows donated value; category missing1 and unknown0
architecture.RTD_head: Shared linear head on contextualized column tokens; no original/unreplaced side input

corruption.donor: Independent uniform own-pretraining-row donor for every selected cell, same column, with replacement; self-donor allowed
corruption.target: Actual changed value, not selection bit. NaN-to-NaN, same categorical value, and signed-zero pairs are negatives.
corruption.loss: Unweighted BCE averaged over all21 positions, including unselected and selected-unchanged negatives
corruption.side_features: No donor index, selection bit, clean features, clean missing indicators, or clean numeric residual enters model
corruption.resampled: New corruption each batch; donor pool and preprocessing fitted only to own inner training rows

proposed_full_pair_not_started.outer: Existing fivefold StratifiedKFold(seed20261018); conditional3fold(seed20261022) only after complete fivefold gates. Both reused label partitions, not independent holdouts.
proposed_full_pair_not_started.inner: Stratified10% of own outer training, seed2026102203+fold(+100threefold); preprocessing, donors and pretraining exclude inner/outer validation and test.
arms: Identical random initial encoder and classifier, no RTD
Same initial encoder and classifier,5epochs RTD before identical supervised phase
proposed_full_pair_not_started.optimizer: AdamW lr1e-3 weight_decay1e-4 gradnorm1; separate cosine schedule down to1e-5 for pretrain and finetune, optimizer reset before finetune
proposed_full_pair_not_started.checkpoint: RTD final epoch5 only; supervised best inner logloss from20fixedepochs, first wins exact ties, no outer selection
proposed_full_pair_not_started.paired_randomness: Same initial state, same supervised data-order and dropout seeds per corresponding epoch; separate corruption generator
proposed_full_pair_not_started.fusion: Each arm fixed .875logit(v12)+.125logit(arm),clip1e-6; no weight search
proposed_full_pair_not_started.gates: After all5folds: both original DeLong95lower>0 and corrected-resampled-t one-sidedalpha.025lower>0 for RTD blend vs v12 AND RTD blend vs scratch blend; same requirements on conditional3fold, then independent implementation audit. No partial-fold selection or rescue.

limitations: Repeated historical SAT validation selection; fold seeds do not create untouched holdouts.
Small self-designed model is not the authors unspecified full Q-FT recipe.
Resource probe measures throughput/correctness, not evidence of satisfaction improvement.
